evals.prompt: Configure a walk animation: start idle, play two alternating passes, and restart when an action counter changes.
assertions: Uses one animation object with preset walk
Uses playState idle and playback iterations 2 with alternate true
Uses trigger for the changing counter
Does not use autoPlay or playback.loop

evals.prompt: Script a left-side punch with 2 damage after 140ms then three victory passes. How do I connect it to the health bars?
assertions: Uses attacker side left and preset punch in a nested attacker object
Uses target damage 2 and delayMs 140 without an explicit target side
Uses victory iterations 3 rather than loops
Reads health and animation from useDuelScript state rather than a second health counter
Imports battle runtime from /battle and types from /types

evals.prompt: I only want a static thumbs-up character. Should I wrap it in AnimationProvider and add a custom sequence?
assertions: Does not require an animation timeline or provider for a static gesture
Notes that head-only portraits ignore the gesture

evals.prompt: My custom hop moves the head up, but its shadow never shrinks. How should I configure the image and the sequence, and what should move during the jump?
assertions: Enables the boolean shadow prop on the image
Sets shadow to airborne on the custom sequence
Animates negative translate.y on the body track and returns it to zero on landing

evals.prompt: Storybook repeats Death (Alt 3). In my game I want that fall to play once and stay down with its ground shadow. What props do I need?
assertions: Uses preset death3 and enables the image shadow
Uses one iteration explicitly or by default and sets holdOnComplete to true
Explains that looping belongs to the preview and the preset supplies falling shadow behavior
